Commentary.Commentary: Well, we can see the England team doing their bowling drills so we assume India have not enforced the follow-on! Our assumption is spot on! Out come Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma. Lauren Bell to begin.
... DAY 2, SESSION 3 ...

For England, the scorecard is not a promising one. Except for Natalie Sciver-Brunt, none of the others managed to cross the 20-run mark and when you are staring down a big first innings score, you need a few big stands but they got none. In the end, they find themselves well behind in this game and need a mammoth task to get back in it. We are not sure if India have enforced the follow-on or not but for now, it is TEA!

An outstanding bowling effort from the Indians and they are well, well ahead in this game. Their bowlers were just on the mark right from the word go. It was Renuka Singh who started things off but the likes of Sneh Rana and Pooja Vastrakar were good too. Even in the field, the Indians were up for it. However, the star of the show was Deepti Sharma, she was introduced as the last bowler and bowled only 33 balls but in those 33 balls, she wrecked havoc. She picked five and has helped India boss this game so far.

OUT! TIMBER! Deepti Sharma has a fifer! What a spell of bowling this has been. A beauty to get the last wicket. This lands on off, it goes on with the arm. Lauren Filer looks to defend but does so for the turn into her. It goes past the outside edge and hits the off pole. England Women HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 136!

England will be happy with how they have replied with the bat. Despite losing two wickets they are scoring at a rate of around 5 with Natalie Sciver-Brunt showing a counter attacking approach. India wouldn't be too disappointed as well. They have bowled well but just the loose deliveries have been hit away. India have been consistent so far and will hope to do the same in the second session. A bit better with their line could help them a lot. A session which is shared by the two teams. Join us in a while after the break for the next session.
